x-usage.selectors: GET/HEAD; source, measure, observation depend on one another in that order. Unknown/empty/duplicate filters:400; unknown IDs or non-retained periods:404; failed selected retrieval/representation:503. A successful source can contain unavailable observations.
x-usage.missingness: Zero is not missing; a nonpositive CPI index fails validation as anomalous. Dash+X is unavailable, plain dash missing. Suppressed requires explicit publisher evidence and review; currently unsupported by this reader. Failed retrieval has no fabricated observations.
x-usage.times: Monthly observation period is separate from publication and retrieval times. Unknown release times remain null. No daily-change staleness rule.
x-usage.revisits: Observation versions include value, dimensions, period, state, footnotes and attribution, not retrieval times or unrelated source-file changes. Same ID/new version means changed observation or qualifications, requiring publisher evidence to classify. File-level provenance can change the response ETag without changing any observation. Failures never return 304.
x-usage.citations: Cite exact observation URL/version, publisher URL, reference month, NSA and base. Retain the response for historical audit; rolling URLs are not permanent vintage archives.
